name: Blueprint Shapes
tagline: Flat white geometry on an electric-blue grid, cut hard to the beat.
description: A beat-cut montage of flat geometric compositions on an electric-blue blueprint grid: white rects slam together into a bar, an iris opens, an outline frame grows while sparkles fly out, a disc squeezes out a dot, stars pop in sequence on a white field and the frame flips to black and gold. Every hit is a hard cut, often on a one-frame RGB-split glitch; inside each shot shapes snap with expo curves. Dither particle discs, broken concentric rings, string-art cards and big thin numerals complete the kit.
bestFor: design studios, agencies and portfolio reels
developer tools, AI and data products
brand idents built on simple geometry
avoidFor: long explanations that need reading time

signature: beat cut: every hit is a hard cut to a new shape composition, often through a one-frame RGB-split glitch
shape match: the last shape of a shot becomes the first of the next (bar → iris tick, dot → ring centre, band → bar)
colour flip: the same layout re-inked in an inverted palette (white/blue → black/gold) on the hit
avoid: drop shadows and 3D bevels on flat shapes

camera: Locked off and flat. Movement comes from the shapes; the only camera moves are a fast ease-in zoom through rings past the lens, a small pull-back (≈8 %) on a colour flip, and an iris that opens to fill the frame.

texture.notes: Clean vector flats with three digital textures used as accents: hard 4×4 Bayer-dithered particle clouds, string-art / moiré line fans, and one-frame glitches (RGB split 4–14 px, scan streaks, edges re-quantised into 6–16 px blocks) on the hits.

lighting: None. Flat colour fields; a soft white halo only around the dither disc's core and the sparkle cores.
sound: A driving electronic track around 120–135 BPM; every cut lands on a transient (kick, impact, tink), glitch frames on snares or risers; shape pops get tiny clicks, colour flips a hit.

beats.label: Rects slam into a bar, iris opens
Frame and sparkles, numeral card, disc to rings
Stars pop, flip to black and gold
Dither disc, rings zoom, band splits to rects

motionSummary: Moves like a graphic beat machine: flat white shapes slam, pop and fly out with expo curves on an electric-blue grid, and every hit is a hard cut, a glitch frame or a colour flip into the next composition.

composition: one or two flat shapes centred on a full-bleed electric-blue field with a hairline grid (22 or 44 px at 720p)
a white outline frame or card on a grid of ghosted panel tiles, with elements flying out of its edges
inverted shots: blue shapes and a dashed-outline blob on a white field with a lavender grid
palette-flip shots: the same layout in black and gold
visual.shapeLanguage: pure flat geometry: rects, bars, discs, dots, rings and broken concentric arcs, diamonds, 4-to-16-point stars and bursts, 8-ray sparkles with a glowing core, hairline boxes and dotted guides; textures as dither clouds and string-art fans
visual.contrast: maximum: pure white on saturated blue, blue on white, gold on black; one red accent kept for numerals

grammar.pacing: fast montage: a new composition every 0.4–1 s (12–30 f), cut to the music's hits; whole sections can strobe at 1–3 f per image
grammar.rhythm: beat-cut: hard cuts on transients; inside a shot one or two snappy moves and a short hold
grammar.easing: expo out [0.16,1,0.3,1] for pops, flights and iris openings; expo in [0.7,0,0.84,0] for slams and zooms past camera; an overshooting spring for star pops; never linear on shapes
grammar.acceleration: violent starts and soft landings: shapes arrive in 2–4 f and settle; slams accelerate into the cut
movement: slam: two shapes accelerate together and merge on the hit
pop: a shape scales 0.3 → 1 with a spring overshoot and a small counter-rotation
fly-out: sparkles leave a frame's edges, growing and turning
squeeze-out: a disc extrudes a dot that shoots away and decelerates
iris: a disc breathes and opens to fill the frame
condense: dither particles gather into a disc and spiral
stroke thinning: rings and frames go from heavy to hairline as they settle
grammar.density: low per shot (one idea, lots of field), high across the edit
grammar.holds: short (4–10 f) after each move; longer only on the numeral card and the end card

transitionPresets.name: Beat cut
transitionPresets.build: hard cut to a new shape composition on the hit; change field colour or grid pitch so the cut reads; no overlap
transitionPresets.sound: the track's own kick or impact

transitionPresets.name: Glitch hit
transitionPresets.build: the last (or first) frame of a shot gets an RGB split of 4–14 px (magenta/green or red/cyan), 10–30 thin scan streaks and optionally a 6–16 px block re-quantise; exactly one frame, then cut

transitionPresets.name: Shape match
transitionPresets.bridge: a shape that exists on both sides of the cut
transitionPresets.build: end a shot on a simple shape (bar, dot, disc, band) at a known size and position; start the next shot on the same shape there and give it a new role (bar → iris tick, dot → ring centre, band → bar); the move continues across the cut
transitionPresets.sound: a tink or click on the cut

transitionPresets.name: Colour flip
transitionPresets.build: keep every shape where it is and re-ink the frame in the inverted palette (white field/blue shapes → void field/gold shapes, hollow shapes swap fill), add one new element (a burst rising expo-out from an edge) and pull the camera back ≈8 % over 8–12 f
transitionPresets.sound: a hit with a short reverse swell before it

transitionPresets.name: Iris open
transitionPresets.bridge: a disc bigger than the frame
transitionPresets.build: a flat disc on the night field breathes in (expo out, 6 f), holds, then opens (expo in, 3 f) until it fills the frame and becomes the next shot's ground
transitionPresets.sound: a rising sweep that peaks on the open

transitionPresets.name: Ring zoom
transitionPresets.build: the ring set scales ×5 with expo in, inner and outer arcs counter-rotating, until the arcs leave the frame; cut on the last frame
transitionPresets.sound: a riser that ends on the cut

archetypes.name: Shape slam
archetypes.purpose: the opening hook and the logo moment: two shapes become one
archetypes.composition: two white rects (or discs) on the blue grid, symmetric about the centre, each ≈25 % of the frame width
archetypes.elements: two flat shapes, the hairline grid
archetypes.motion: they accelerate together (expo in, 10–12 f), narrowing as they go, and merge into a bar on the hit; reversed (expo out) they split apart

archetypes.name: Frame and sparkles
archetypes.purpose: a title or feature card: the thing in the frame
archetypes.composition: a white outline frame (≈50 % of the frame) on a grid of ghosted panel tiles; two 8-ray sparkles at its mid-left and mid-right; optionally a white card with a big thin numeral or word inside
archetypes.elements: outline frame, panel tiles, sparkles, card, display numeral in the red accent, dotted string-art fan
archetypes.motion: the frame grows (expo out) while its stroke thins from heavy to hairline; sparkles fly out diagonally, growing and turning; the card cuts in on the next hit
archetypes.camera: locked; the grid scales with the frame

archetypes.name: Primitive play
archetypes.purpose: a single idea as a tiny shape event: a dot, a ring, a square popping off a bar
archetypes.composition: one disc, ring or square near the centre on the blue grid; lots of empty field
archetypes.elements: disc, dot, concentric ring with faint halo rings, square and bar, hairline guide boxes
archetypes.motion: a disc squeezes out a dot that shoots away (expo out); a ring settles while its stroke thins; a square pops off a bar and tilts

archetypes.name: Star bloom
archetypes.purpose: the energy peak: many things at once, then the flip
archetypes.composition: inverted: white field with a lavender grid; a blue blob with a dashed outline pushes in from one side, a dither cloud on the other; stars and bursts bloom inside the blob
archetypes.elements: blob, dashed edge, dither cloud, 4–16 point stars and bursts (filled and hollow-outlined), a triangle
archetypes.motion: the blob pushes in (expo out); stars pop one per frame with a spring overshoot; on the hit the whole layout flips to black and gold and a burst rises from the bottom edge
archetypes.camera: locked, then an 8 % pull-back on the flip

archetypes.name: Texture field
archetypes.purpose: atmosphere between beats: dither discs, broken rings, string-art
archetypes.composition: a full-frame pattern: dither particles condensing into a disc on a pale grey field, broken concentric arcs, or a moiré line fan
archetypes.elements: Bayer-dithered particles, white core disc, spokes, broken arcs, dotted fans
archetypes.motion: particles condense and spiral into arms; rings strobe solid/ghost every 1–2 f while growing, then zoom past camera

beats.purpose: the hook: two shapes become one
beats.motion: rects slam into a bar; the bar becomes the iris tick and the iris opens

beats.purpose: what it is: the name, the number, the feature
beats.motion: frame grows, sparkles fly out, the card with the numeral cuts in; small shape events on each hit
stars pop one per frame, then the colour flip

beats.purpose: a texture breath before the end
beats.motion: dither condenses, rings strobe and zoom
the card or numeral holds, then a white band narrows into the bar (the mark)

sequence.cutRhythm: hard cuts on the music's transients, 12–30 f per shot; one-frame glitches on about half the cuts; a 1–3 f strobe section is allowed once per film

scenes.action: two white rects slam into a bar on the blue grid; glitch; the bar is the tick inside a navy iris that breathes and opens
an outline frame grows on the panel grid while two sparkles fly out; on the hit a white card cuts in with the launch date as a big thin numeral
a disc squeezes out a dot that shoots right; match cut on the dot to concentric rings thinning to hairlines
white field: a blue blob pushes in, stars pop one per frame; glitch; the layout flips to black and gold and a burst rises
dither particles condense into a disc and spiral; broken rings strobe and zoom past camera
end card: a white band narrows on blue into the bar, the product's mark; no tag or handle

elements.text: almost none: one big thin numeral or one short word in the display face (weight 100–200, red accent or white) on a card; tiny mono marks at most
elements.logo: built from the shape kit: the slam bar, a ring with a dot, a star; appears as a match on a hit
elements.icons: redrawn as flat primitives (disc, ring, star, arrow) in white or blue
elements.images: not used; a product appears as a flat silhouette or a dithered shape
elements.ui: as hairline boxes, dotted guides and outline frames, never as screenshots
elements.shapes: the whole language: rects, bars, discs, dots, rings, broken arcs, diamonds, stars, bursts, sparkles
elements.background: electric-blue field with a hairline grid; white field with a lavender grid; navy, void black or pale grey for single shots
elements.particles: hard Bayer-dithered dots (clouds, discs, spirals); never soft bokeh

audio.sync: every cut sits on a transient within ±2 f; glitch frames on snares or risers; star pops one per 16th; colour flips on downbeats; the iris and ring zoom ride risers that peak on the cut
audio.sfx: tiny clicks for pops, digital crackles for glitch frames, a sub hit for colour flips, a riser into ring zooms; the track carries the rest
